manual.assorteddoubledoors.chapter.doubl:
You can have two doors side by side and opening one door will open the other. The same goes for a large group of trapdoors, and for fence gates stacked on or beside each other.

Sneak to open just one. Doors, trapdoors and gates from other mods should work too.
manual.assorteddoubledoors.description: One click opens both doors of a pair, a whole trapdoor hatch, or a run of fence gates.
manual.assorteddoubledoors.title: Assorted Double Doors
